posting.title: 🤖 Give Your AI Its Own Computer: Meet OpenBot
posting.caption: This free AI tool gives your AI coworkers their own computer. It's OpenBot by CopilotKit, MIT licensed, over eight thousand stars. Each bot gets a real browser, its own files, and only the tools you grant. Every action hits one gateway: decided before it happens, recorded after. Hits something risky? You take the wheel, like an intern that asks first. Bring any AG-UI agent and host it yourself. Comment the word 'COWORKER' and I'll send you the link and tutorial for this repo.
posting.linkedin:
🤖 What if your AI assistant had its own desk, its own browser, and a manager watching every move?

Most AI tools run in a black box you don't control, on infrastructure you don't own, with no record of what they actually did.

OpenBot by CopilotKit gives every AI coworker a real computer of its own:

✅ Its own browser with its own logins, its own files, and only the tools you grant
✅ One gateway that decides every action against your policy before it happens, and records it after
✅ Watch the bot work on its own screen, take the wheel when it hits something risky, hand it back when done
✅ Answers come back as UI components, not just walls of text
✅ Built on AG-UI, so it runs LangGraph, Mastra, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, Google ADK, or hand-written agents
✅ Ships with General Assistant, Knowledge, Risk Analyst, and ten more example coworkers
✅ Docker Compose spins up everything, your data stays in your own PostgreSQL, you bring your own model key

8,657 stars. 1,097 forks. MIT licensed. A template to clone and own, not a hosted product.

Install with Docker Compose and run it on your own infrastructure.

Would you trust an AI coworker with its own browser and files? 👇
